author: Neeraj Chauhan
review_text: eSewa is a digital wallet and online payment service from Nepal that allows users to perform various financial transactions through their mobile devices or computers. With eSewa, users can pay utility bills, recharge mobile phones, send and receive money, and make online purchases conveniently. Launched in 2009, eSewa is Nepal's first online payment gateway and is widely used across the country for its secure and fast digital transaction services. (Neeraj chauhan) Nepal
